➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

x2+x−6x2−9​ and x−2x−3​ give the same output for almost every x — but at x=−3 the first one breaks. Knowing exactly where is half the marks.x2+x−6x2−9​ 和 x−2x−3​ 几乎对所有 x 都相等——但在 x=−3 处前者没有意义。准确找出这些点就拿到了一半的分。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  1. NPVs: values that make the DENOMINATOR zero — factor it, set each factor =0.不允许值：使分母为零的值——把分母分解，每个因式 =0。
  2. State NPVs from the ORIGINAL expression; a cancelled factor still counts.从原式写不允许值；约掉的因式照样算。
  3. Cancel FACTORS, never terms; b−aa−b​=−1.只能约因式，不能约项；b−aa−b​=−1。
BCAC​=BA​,B=0, C=0
b−aa−b​=−1,a=b

🧗 The hard part难点 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简

A denominator that starts with −x2分母以 −x2 开头

The opposite factor is hidden until you take out −1, and the sign of the answer flips.不提出 −1 就看不出相反因式，而且结果要变号。

  1. 6−x−x2=−(x2+x−6)=−(x+3)(x−2)
  2. NPVs now: x=−3, 2现在写不允许值：x=−3, 2
  3. 6−x−x22x2−8​=−(x+3)(x−2)2(x−2)(x+2)​=−x+32(x+2)​
Try试一试
Simplify 10+3x−x2x2−25​ and state the NPVs.化简 10+3x−x2x2−25​，并写出不允许值。
Answer答案
−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​, x=5, −2−(x−5)(x+2)(x−5)(x+5)​=−x+2x+5​，x=5, −2

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Non-permissible values & simplifying不允许值与化简
  • x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → nothing cancels across +.x+3x+6​=36​ ✗ → 加号连接的不能约。
  • Setting the numerator =0 for NPVs ✗ → only the denominator matters.令分子为 0 求不允许值 ✗ → 只看分母。
🎯
Write the NPVs on line 1, before simplifying — then you cannot lose them.第一行先写不允许值，再化简——就不会丢。

Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

Multiplying x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ the long way gives a degree-3 mess. Factor first and almost everything cancels before you multiply.硬乘 x2−4xx2−9​⋅x+32x​ 会得到一堆三次式。先分解，乘之前几乎全都约掉了。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 30 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  1. Multiply: factor everything, cancel any top with any bottom, then multiply what is left.乘法：全部分解，任一分子可与任一分母约分，再把剩下的相乘。
  2. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the SECOND fraction.除法：乘以第二个分式的倒数。
  3. Division NPVs: both denominators AND the numerator of the divisor.除法的不允许值：两个分母，再加上除式的分子。
BA​⋅DC​=BDAC​
BA​÷DC​=BA​⋅CD​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除

All the NPVs in a division除法里的全部不允许值

After flipping, the divisor numerator hides in the denominator and its restriction gets missed.翻转后除式的分子跑到分母里，它的限制最容易漏。

  1. x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​: denominators x=3, 0x−3x+2​÷xx2−4​：分母给出 x=3, 0
  2. Divisor numerator: x2−4=0 → x=±2除式分子：x2−4=0 → x=±2
  3. Flip & cancel: x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​翻转并约分：x−3x+2​⋅(x−2)(x+2)x​=(x−3)(x−2)x​
  4. NPVs: x=−2,0,2,3不允许值：x=−2,0,2,3
Try试一试
Simplify x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​ and state all NPVs.化简 x+4x−1​÷x−1x2−9​，并写出全部不允许值。
Answer答案
(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​, x=−4, ±3, 1(x+4)(x−3)(x+3)(x−1)2​，x=−4, ±3, 1

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Multiplying & dividing有理式乘除
  • In ÷x+1x−5​, forgetting x=5 ✗ — it lands on the bottom after flipping.÷x+1x−5​ 漏写 x=5 ✗——翻转后它到了分母。
  • Cancelling across +: in xx+3​ nothing cancels.跨加号约分：xx+3​ 什么都不能约。
🎯
List the NPVs before you flip — three places, one line.翻转之前先列不允许值——三个来源，一行写完。

Adding & subtracting有理式加减

21​+31​=65​ — you already know how. Adding x−23​−x+12​ is the exact same move: common denominator, then combine the tops.21​+31​=65​ 你早就会。x−23​−x+12​ 是一模一样的操作：通分，再合并分子。

Difficulty难度 ●●○
⏱ 35 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  1. Factor every denominator; LCD = each different factor at its highest power.把每个分母分解；最简公分母＝每个不同因式取最高次幂。
  2. Rewrite over the LCD, then add or subtract the NUMERATORS only.化成同分母，只对分子加减。
  3. Subtracting: bracket the whole numerator, −(x−2)=−x+2; finish by factoring and cancelling.相减时整个分子加括号，−(x−2)=−x+2；最后分解分子看能否约分。
BA​±DC​=BDAD±BC​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减

Subtracting over a factored LCD在分解后的公分母上做减法

Three things go wrong at once: missing factors, the minus sign, and the final cancel.三件事同时容易出错：漏乘因式、减号分配、最后约分。

  1. x2−95​−x−32​: LCD (x−3)(x+3)x2−95​−x−32​：公分母 (x−3)(x+3)
  2. Top: 5−2(x+3) — bracket it分子：5−2(x+3)——加括号
  3. =5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​, x=±3=5−2x−6=−2x−1 → (x−3)(x+3)−2x−1​，x=±3
Try试一试
Simplify x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​.化简 x−4x​−x2−x−12x+24​。
Answer答案
(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​, x=4, −3(x−4)(x+3)x(x+3)−(x+24)​=(x−4)(x+3)(x+6)(x−4)​=x+3x+6​，x=4, −3

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Adding & subtracting有理式加减
  • x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​.x1​+y1​=x+y2​ ✗ → xyx+y​。
  • x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2: the minus hits every term.x−(x−2)=−2 ✗ → +2：减号作用于每一项。
🎯
Opposite denominators (x−3 and 3−x): flip the sign of one fraction instead of multiplying them.分母互为相反数（x−3 与 3−x）：把其中一个分式变号即可，不用相乘。

➗ Rational Expressions & Equations有理式与分式方程

Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Two hoses together fill a hot tub in 4 hours, and the big one alone is 6 hours faster than the small one. How long does each take alone? Rates add as fractions — and one of the two answers you get is impossible.两根水管一起 4 小时灌满一个热水池，大水管单独灌比小水管快 6 小时。各自单独要多久？效率是分数相加——而你算出的两个答案里有一个不可能。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  1. NPVs first; then multiply EVERY term (whole numbers too) by the LCD.先写不允许值；再把每一项（包括整数项）都乘以公分母。
  2. An answer equal to an NPV is extraneous — reject it; all rejected → no solution.等于不允许值的解是增根，舍去；全部舍去 → 无解。
  3. Work: rates add, t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​. Travel: time =speeddistance​.工作问题：效率相加，t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​。行程问题：时间 =速度路程​。
t1​1​+t2​1​=T1​
t=vd​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题

Turning a work or travel story into an equation把工作／行程问题列成方程

The equation comes from rates or times, not from the hours given, so students add the wrong things.方程来自效率或时间的关系，而不是题目里的小时数本身，所以常加错东西。

  1. Pipe A: x h, B: x+5 h, together 6 h → rates x1​, x+51​, 61​A 管 x 小时，B 管 x+5 小时，合作 6 小时 → 效率 x1​, x+51​, 61​
  2. x1​+x+51​=61​
  3. ×6x(x+5): 6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0两边乘 6x(x+5)：6(x+5)+6x=x(x+5) → x2−7x−30=0
  4. x=10 (reject −3): A 10 h, B 15 hx=10（舍去 −3）：A 用 10 小时，B 用 15 小时
Try试一试
A drone flies 12 km into a 4 km/h headwind and 12 km back with the wind, 1.6 h in all. Find its speed in still air.一架无人机逆风（风速 4 km/h）飞 12 km，再顺风飞回 12 km，共用 1.6 小时。求它在无风时的速度。
Answer答案
s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h (reject −1).s−412​+s+412​=1.6 ⇒ s2−15s−16=0 ⇒ s=16 km/h（舍去 −1）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Rational equations & applications分式方程与应用题
  • 1+x2−412​: the 1 stays 1 ✗ → it becomes x2−4.1+x2−412​ 里的 1 不乘 ✗ → 它要变成 x2−4。
  • Together time =t1​+t2​ ✗ → add the RATES; together is faster than either alone.合作时间 =t1​+t2​ ✗ → 应该把效率相加；合作比任何一个人单干都快。
🎯
In word problems, make a small table (rate or speed, time) before writing the equation.应用题先列个小表（效率或速度、时间），再列方程。

cards.f: Where do NPVs come from?不允许值从哪里来？
cards.b: Denominator =0, in the original expression.原式的分母 =0。

cards.f: 7−xx−7​ = ?7−xx−7​＝？
cards.b: −1, x=7.−1，x=7。

cards.f: Can you cancel the x in xx+2​?xx+2​ 中的 x 能约吗？
cards.b: No — x is a term on top, not a factor.不能——分子里 x 是项，不是因式。

cards.f: NPVs of x2+41​?x2+41​ 的不允许值？
cards.b: None: x2+4 is never 0.没有：x2+4 永远不为 0。

cards.f: First move to simplify?化简的第一步？
cards.b: Factor top and bottom completely.分子分母完全分解。

cards.f: Dividing rational expressions: first move?有理式相除第一步？
cards.b: Factor everything and list NPVs (including the divisor’s numerator), then flip.全部分解并列出不允许值（包括除式分子），再颠倒。

cards.f: Can a top cancel with a bottom of the OTHER fraction?一个分式的分子能和另一个分式的分母约吗？
cards.b: Yes, when multiplying.能，乘法时可以。

cards.f: 3x​÷6x​ = ?3x​÷6x​＝？
cards.b: 3x​⋅x6​=2, x=0.3x​⋅x6​=2，x=0。

cards.f: Why factor before multiplying?为什么要先分解再相乘？
cards.b: Cancelling early keeps degrees low and errors rare.先约分次数低，不容易错。

cards.f: LCD of (x−1)(x+2) and (x+2)2?(x−1)(x+2) 与 (x+2)2 的最简公分母？
cards.b: (x−1)(x+2)2.(x−1)(x+2)2。

cards.f: Subtracting a fraction — what do you put around its numerator?减去一个分式时，分子外面加什么？
cards.b: Brackets, then distribute the minus.括号，再分配减号。

cards.f: x−54​−5−x3​ = ?x−54​−5−x3​＝？
cards.b: x−54​+x−53​=x−57​.x−54​+x−53​=x−57​。

cards.f: Last step after combining?合并后的最后一步？
cards.b: Factor the numerator and cancel if you can.分解分子，能约就约。

cards.f: First line of every rational equation?每道分式方程的第一行？
cards.b: The NPVs.不允许值。

cards.f: Rate of someone who finishes a job in 5 h?5 小时完成一件工作的效率？
cards.b: 51​ job per hour.每小时 51​。

cards.f: All your answers are NPVs. Conclusion?所有答案都是不允许值，结论？
cards.b: No solution.方程无解。

cards.f: Boat speed v in still water, current 2 km/h. Upstream speed?静水船速 v，水流 2 km/h，逆流速度？
cards.b: v−2 (downstream v+2).v−2（顺流 v+2）。

cards.f: Context answer negative or zero time/speed?实际问题算出负的或零的时间/速度？
cards.b: Reject it and say why.舍去并说明理由。

quiz.q: State the non-permissible values of x2+3x−10x2−4​.写出 x2+3x−10x2−4​ 的不允许值。
opts: x=±2
x=−5
x=5, −2
x=−5, 2
quiz.hint: Factor the bottom; each factor =0.分解分母，每个因式 =0。
quiz.why: Correct: x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2).正确：x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2)。
whys: Used the numerator; NPVs come from the denominator only.用了分子；不允许值只看分母。
Cancelled (x−2) first and lost its restriction; take NPVs from the original.先约掉 (x−2)，把它的限制丢了；要从原式写。
Sign slip: (x+5)(x−2)=0 gives x=−5 and x=2.符号错：(x+5)(x−2)=0 得 x=−5 和 x=2。
Correct: x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2).正确：x2+3x−10=(x+5)(x−2)。

opts: x+23​, x=±2
−x+23​, x=−2
−x+23​, x=±2

quiz.hint: Factor both: 3(x−2) over −(x−2)(x+2).上下都分解：3(x−2) 比 −(x−2)(x+2)。
quiz.why: Correct: −(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​, x=±2.正确：−(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​，x=±2。
whys: Missed the opposite factor: 4−x2=(2−x)(2+x), and 2−xx−2​=−1.没注意相反因式：4−x2=(2−x)(2+x)，2−xx−2​=−1。
Lost the NPV x=2 by stating restrictions after cancelling.约分后才写限制，丢了 x=2。
Correct: −(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​, x=±2.正确：−(x−2)(x+2)3(x−2)​=−x+23​，x=±2。
Thought nothing cancels because x−2 and 2−x look different; they are opposites.以为 x−2 和 2−x 不一样所以不能约；它们互为相反数。

quiz.q: Simplify 3xx2−25​⋅x+56x2​.化简 3xx2−25​⋅x+56x2​。
opts: 2(x−5)
2x(x+5)
2x(x−5)

quiz.hint: Factor x2−25, then cancel (x+5) and 3x into 6x2.分解 x2−25，约去 (x+5)，6x2 与 3x 约分。
quiz.why: Correct: 3x(x−5)(x+5)​⋅x+56x2​=2x(x−5).正确：3x(x−5)(x+5)​⋅x+56x2​=2x(x−5)。

quiz.q: Simplify x+3x2−1​÷x2−9x−1​ and give all NPVs.化简 x+3x2−1​÷x2−9x−1​，并写出全部不允许值。

(x+1)(x−3), x=±3

quiz.why: Correct: x+3(x−1)(x+1)​⋅x−1(x−3)(x+3)​=(x+1)(x−3); NPVs −3,3,1.正确：x+3(x−1)(x+1)​⋅x−1(x−3)(x+3)​=(x+1)(x−3)；不允许值 −3,3,1。
whys: Took NPVs only from the first denominator.只从第一个分母取了不允许值。

quiz.q: One volunteer paints a fence alone in 3 h. With a second volunteer, it takes 2 h. How long would the second volunteer take alone?一名志愿者单独刷完一段围栏要 3 小时，和第二名志愿者一起刷要 2 小时。第二名志愿者单独刷要多久？
opts: 1 h
61​ h
1.2 h
6 h
quiz.hint: Rates add: 31​+t1​=21​.效率相加：31​+t1​=21​。
quiz.why: Correct: 31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 h.正确：31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 小时。
whys: Subtracted times (3−2); times do not combine — rates do.把时间相减（3−2）；时间不能直接加减，要用效率。
Found the rate 61​ fence per hour and reported it as the time; flip it.求出效率 61​（每小时刷 61​）就当成时间了；要取倒数。
Added the rates 31​+21​ instead of subtracting 21​−31​.把效率相加成 31​+21​，应是 21​−31​。
Correct: 31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 h.正确：31​+t1​=21​ ⇒ t1​=61​ ⇒ t=6 小时。
